    Profile

    Hailing from the Luxuria Belt Region, Quence is a Spacetime Manipulator who belongs to The Infinite Serpent. He has thrown aside all norms in his research to overthrow the Cursed Beasts. Spacetime Manipulation is his last, best hope at achieving his goals. He deals ruthlessly with any obstacle, but is otherwise a pleasant and frank individual.

    Origin: The Luxuria Belt Region
    Gender: Male
    Height: 180cm
    Weight: 57kg
    Birthday: Dec 11
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Nightmare Cherry Blossom
    Likes: Chatting
    Hobbies: Reminiscing
    Illust: 城（G-ROW）
    CV: 中村悠一
